title: The Sixteen Principal Stars
author: Joseph G. Dalton
description: Joseph G. Dalton focuses on sixteen stars and their significance within astrological interpretation. The work offers a historical introduction to the use of fixed stars alongside the more familiar planetary framework.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/sixteenprincipal00dalt).
